title: Vee Rating & Rating Updates
summary: Added a VeeRating form wrapper and rebuilt editable Rating on top of Reka UI's Rating primitive.
body:
- [**VeeRating**](/forms/veerating): A Vee-Validate rating field with a label, hint, animated error message, and accessible labelling. All `UiRating` props (`step`, `clearable`, `icon`, `size`, ...) are forwarded. Install it with `ui-thing@latest add vee-rating`. Check out the documentation [here](/forms/veerating).
- [**Rating**](/components/rating): Editable ratings now use Reka UI's Rating primitive, adding keyboard navigation, radio-group semantics, and form support (`name`, `required`). New props: `step`, `clearable`, `disabled`, `name`, `required`, and `dir`. Read-only ratings still display any decimal value and now expose an `aria-label`. Editable ratings with a fractional value need `step="0.5"` to show a half star, and `starHover` now emits the hovered step.
